_note: Board outlines and mounting holes in mm; size is [length, width, thickness] (thickness null = not published). Notes starting with APPROXIMATE come from secondary sources or clones that vary: ask the user to measure before a tight fit. source says where the numbers come from. Holes are [x, y] from the board's lower-left corner, seen from above with the long side along x. Values match NopSCADlib's pcbs.scad; check the datasheet when a fit is critical. In OpenSCAD the NopSCADlib constant gives the full board with connectors: pcb(TYPE), and pcb_cutouts(TYPE) cuts the openings for its connectors in an enclosure wall (NopSCADlib centres the board on the origin).

raspberry-pi-5.name: Raspberry Pi 5
raspberry-pi-5.notes: Same outline and hole pattern as the Pi 4; the ports differ (no NopSCADlib model, use RPI4 for the outline only).

raspberry-pi-4.name: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B
raspberry-pi-4.notes: USB-A and Ethernet stick out about 2-8.5 mm past the short edge at x = 85.

raspberry-pi-zero.name: Raspberry Pi Zero / Zero W / Zero 2 W

raspberry-pi-pico.name: Raspberry Pi Pico / Pico W
raspberry-pi-pico.notes: Micro-USB (USB-C on some clones) at the short edge x = 0.

arduino-uno.name: Arduino Uno R3
arduino-uno.notes: USB-B and the barrel jack stick out past the short edge at x = 0.

arduino-nano.name: Arduino Nano
arduino-nano.notes: Usually soldered to headers or a socket instead of screwed down; pins at 0.1" pitch, rows 15.24 mm apart.

esp32-devkit.name: ESP32 DevKit V1 (DOIT, 30 pins)
esp32-devkit.notes: Clones vary by a millimetre or two (38-pin versions are about 55 x 28 mm): leave 1 mm clearance and ask the user to measure theirs. Micro-USB at the short edge x = 0; pin rows 25.4 mm apart.

seeed-xiao.name: Seeed Studio XIAO (ESP32-C3/S3/C6, SAMD21, RP2040 ...)
seeed-xiao.notes: No mounting holes: hold it in a pocket or on its castellated pins (2 x 7, rows 15.24 mm apart). USB-C centred on the short edge x = 21, sticking out about 1.8 mm. The ESP32-C3/S3 use an external U.FL antenna (leave room for the cable); the S3 Sense with its camera board is 15 mm tall. Size from Seeed's wiki.

18650-cell.name: 18650 Li-ion cell
18650-cell.notes: Cylinder 18.3-18.6 mm diameter, 65 mm long unprotected; protected cells with button tops are up to about 70 mm. Holders: allow 19 mm diameter and the spring contacts' length.

relay-module-1ch.name: 1-channel 5 V relay module (HW-803)
relay-module-1ch.notes: The relay sticks up about 15-19 mm; screw terminals on one short edge. Many layouts exist: ask the user to measure theirs.

rotary-encoder-ky040.name: KY-040 rotary encoder module
rotary-encoder-ky040.notes: Shaft 6 mm with a 7 mm threaded bushing (M7): a panel hole of 7.5 mm holds it with its nut.

lcd-1602.name: LCD 1602A character display (16x2)
lcd-1602.notes: The display frame on top is 71.3 x 24.3 x 7 mm, centred on the board; the visible area is about 64.5 x 14.5 mm. An I2C backpack on the back adds about 12 mm.

buck-converter-mp1584.name: MP1584EN 3 A buck converter module
buck-converter-mp1584.notes: No mounting holes (the corner holes are the IN/OUT pads): hold it in a pocket or on standoffs glued under it. Components up to about 4 mm high, the trimpot on top.

charger-tp4056.name: TP4056 Li-ion charger module
charger-tp4056.notes: No mounting holes; micro-USB (USB-C on newer ones) at the short edge x = 0, sticking out about 1 mm. Hold it in a pocket with a slot for the USB plug.

boost-converter-mt3608.name: MT3608 boost converter module
boost-converter-mt3608.notes: No mounting holes (the 4 holes are the IN/OUT pads); the trimpot is about 10 mm high.

fan-30mm.name: 30 mm fan (30x30x10)
fan-30mm.notes: Screw holes 24 mm apart; blade opening about 27 mm diameter (cut a round hole or a grille of that size). Self-tapping fan screws or M3 screws through the frame.

fan-40mm.name: 40 mm fan (40x40x11)
fan-40mm.notes: Screw holes 32 mm apart; blade opening about 37 mm diameter (cut a round hole or a grille of that size). Self-tapping fan screws or M3 screws through the frame.

fan-50mm.name: 50 mm fan (50x50x15)
fan-50mm.notes: Screw holes 40 mm apart; blade opening about 48 mm diameter (cut a round hole or a grille of that size). Self-tapping fan screws or M4 screws through the frame.

fan-60mm.name: 60 mm fan (60x60x15)
fan-60mm.notes: Screw holes 50 mm apart; blade opening about 57 mm diameter (cut a round hole or a grille of that size). Self-tapping fan screws or M4 screws through the frame.

fan-80mm.name: 80 mm fan (80x80x25)
fan-80mm.notes: Screw holes 71.5 mm apart; blade opening about 75 mm diameter (cut a round hole or a grille of that size). Self-tapping fan screws or M4 screws through the frame.

fan-120mm.name: 120 mm fan (120x120x25)
fan-120mm.notes: Screw holes 105 mm apart; blade opening about 116 mm diameter (cut a round hole or a grille of that size). Self-tapping fan screws or M4 screws through the frame.

nema17-stepper.name: NEMA 17 stepper motor
nema17-stepper.notes: Face 42.3 mm square; M3 threaded holes 31 mm apart; centre boss 22 mm diameter, 2 mm high (cut a 22.5 mm hole); shaft 5 mm with a flat. Body length 20-60 mm (47 mm common): ask which one.

esp32-devkitc-v4.name: Espressif ESP32-DevKitC V4
esp32-devkitc-v4.notes: PCB 48.2 x 27.9 mm; the WROOM module's antenna sticks out 6.2 mm past the far end (x = 48.2 to 54.4), so the overall length is 54.4 mm - keep metal and screws away from the antenna. No mounting holes: hold it in a pocket or on its pins (2 x 19, 2.54 mm pitch, rows 25.4 mm apart). Micro-USB on the short edge x = 0. Thickness not published.

esp32-s3-devkitc-1.name: Espressif ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1
esp32-s3-devkitc-1.notes: APPROXIMATE: about 62.7 x 25.5 mm (sources differ on the width, 25.4-26 mm), plus about 6 mm of module antenna past the far end. No mounting holes. 2 x 22 pins at 2.54 mm; the row spacing is 22.86 mm in Espressif's footprint but 25.4 mm was measured on a real board - ask the user to measure before fixing the pin positions. Two USB-C on the short edge x = 0. Espressif's DXF is the exact reference.

esp32-c3-devkitm-1.name: Espressif ESP32-C3-DevKitM-1
esp32-c3-devkitm-1.notes: APPROXIMATE size (38.9 x 25.4 mm without the antenna, which adds about 7 mm at the far end). No mounting holes. 2 x 15 pins at 2.54 mm, rows 22.86 mm apart (Espressif footprint). USB at the short edge x = 0.

esp32-c6-devkitc-1.name: Espressif ESP32-C6-DevKitC-1
esp32-c6-devkitc-1.notes: APPROXIMATE: 51.8 x 25.4 mm PCB; with the module antenna about 58 mm long. No mounting holes. 2 x 16 pins at 2.54 mm, rows 22.86 mm apart (Espressif footprint). Two USB-C on the short edge x = 0.
esp32-c6-devkitc-1.source: https://github.com/espressif/kicad-libraries (ESP32-C6-DevKitC-1.kicad_mod); size from Espressif's PCB PDF via search

esp32-c3-supermini.name: ESP32-C3 SuperMini (generic)
esp32-c3-supermini.notes: APPROXIMATE, clones vary (22.5-23 x 18 mm): ask the user to measure theirs. No mounting holes: hold it in a pocket. 2 x 8 pins at 2.54 mm, rows 15.24 mm apart. USB-C on a short edge; small ceramic/PCB antenna at the other end.

lolin-s2-mini.name: Wemos/LOLIN S2 mini, C3 mini, S3 mini
lolin-s2-mini.notes: Same outline for all three. USB-C on the short edge x = 0; that end is narrower: the last 7.7 mm (x = 0-7.7) are 23.5 mm wide (a 1.9 mm step on one side). Corners R4 at the hole end, R1 at the USB end. Pins at 2.54 mm in rows 1.27 mm in from the long edges (outer rows 22.86 mm apart; S2/S3 mini have double rows, C3 mini single).

lolin-d32.name: Wemos/LOLIN D32
lolin-d32.notes: The two holes flank the WROOM antenna at the far end (x = 57); keep metal away from the antenna. Micro-USB and a JST-PH 2.0 battery connector on the short edge x = 0. 16 pins per side.

esp32-cam.name: ESP32-CAM (AI-Thinker)
esp32-cam.notes: APPROXIMATE (27 x 40.5 x 4.5 mm +-0.2, clones vary). No mounting holes and no USB (the separate ESP32-CAM-MB adapter adds micro-USB and makes it about 20 mm taller). The camera sits on a short ribbon cable; the microSD slot is on the short edge opposite the antenna. 2 x 8 pins.
esp32-cam.source: AI-Thinker ESP32-CAM datasheet (via search, not checked)

feather-esp32-v2.name: Adafruit Feather ESP32 V2
feather-esp32-v2.notes: Feather standard 2.0 x 0.9 inch. USB-C centred on the short edge x = 0, sticking out about 1.1 mm; the module and antenna at the far end. Pins: 16 at y = 1.27 and 12 at y = 21.59 (2.54 mm pitch).

feather-esp32-s3.name: Adafruit Feather ESP32-S3
feather-esp32-s3.notes: Not symmetric: the two holes at the far (antenna) end are 2.2 mm and sit 1.84 mm from the long edges; the USB-end ones are 2.5 mm, 2.54 mm in. USB-C centred on the short edge x = 0, sticking out about 1.1 mm. Pins: 16 at y = 1.27 and 12 at y = 21.59.

m5stack-atom.name: M5Stack Atom Lite / AtomS3 Lite
m5stack-atom.notes: A finished module in its own case: 24 x 24 x 10 mm (AtomS3 Lite 9.5 mm, Atom Matrix 14 mm). USB-C on one side; an M2 threaded hole in the back (position not published - ask the user or hold it in a 24.3 mm pocket).

lilygo-t-display.name: LILYGO T-Display (ESP32)
lilygo-t-display.notes: No mounting holes. 1.14" display on top. 2 x 12 pins at 2.54 mm, rows 22.91 mm apart, 1.26 and 1.02 mm in from the long edges; they start 16.1 mm from one end. USB-C on a short edge. Measured from LILYGO's STEP model.

lilygo-t-display-s3.name: LILYGO T-Display-S3
lilygo-t-display-s3.notes: APPROXIMATE (measured from LILYGO's STL): PCB about 60.8 x 25.5 x 1.2 mm; with the display and parts about 62.0 x 26.0 x 9.9 mm overall; the display module is 49.9 x 25.95 mm. USB-C face about 1.2 mm past the PCB edge. No mounting holes found.
